lines: You cook on Wednesday and Saturday, and that is what was kept.
The shared dish is vegan: that is what Lubna eats.
To stay inside it, expensive proteins give first, then out-of-season produce, then variety — never the portions.

dishes.name: Pepper Chickpea Smash
dishes.title: Chickpeas, avocado, red pepper and cucumber
dishes.method: Roughly crush the chickpeas and avocado with the lemon, olive oil and black pepper. Fold through diced red pepper and cucumber, then divide between two plates.
dishes.why: This is a quick named plate with a loud vegetable for the two people eating lunch at home.

dishes.name: Cucumber Chickpea Plate
dishes.title: Chickpeas, avocado, cucumber and red pepper
dishes.method: Mix the chickpeas, avocado, lemon, olive oil and black pepper. Add diced cucumber and red pepper and serve.
dishes.why: This keeps lunch fresh and simple while giving Roxane a separate named plate from the shared dish.

dishes.name: Aubergine Lentil Rice Bowls
dishes.title: Aubergine lentil stew, spinach and rice
dishes.method: Reheat the two named portions of aubergine lentil stew and rice until piping hot, then serve the stew over the rice.
dishes.why: For the table, we traded separate hot lunch cooking for a fresh chickpea plate, while dinner carries the warm reheatable element everyone asked for.

dishes.name: Herby Aubergine Rice Bowl
dishes.title: Aubergine lentil stew, rice and cucumber
dishes.method: Reheat the named stew and rice until piping hot. Top with diced cucumber and parsley before serving.
dishes.why: This gives Roxane a separate plate with a fresh contrast to the warm batch.

preparations.title: Aubergine lentil stew
preparations.method: Dice the aubergines and onions. Warm the oil in a large pot, soften the onions for 5 minutes, then add aubergine and cumin for 5 minutes. Stir in lentils, tomatoes, water, salt and pepper; simmer for 25 minutes until tender. Fold in spinach for the final 2 minutes, then weigh 300 g ready stew into each named box.

preparations.title: Steamed rice
preparations.method: Rinse the rice, add it to a covered pot with water and salt, bring to the boil, then simmer for 15 minutes and rest covered for 5 minutes. Weigh 150 g cooked rice into each named box and refrigerate promptly.

cooking_sessions.run_through: Start the rice first and leave it covered to cook. While it heats, dice the aubergines and onions and begin the stew. Simmer the stew while the rice rests, fold in the spinach, then weigh 300 g stew and 150 g rice into each named dinner box and refrigerate promptly.
